issues.title: Prose next step disagrees with structured next_step
issues.evidence: Real-provider samples show structured next_step diverging from prose: boilerplate "围绕…先做一个小动作，把结果带回来" or mixed EN/ZH text vs specific prose next step (evidence/real-provider-latency-glm53-*.json). Root: coach_finalize structured next_step contract; needs prompt/contract fix validated against real provider.
issues.acceptance: One next-step object drives prose and UI
issues.resolution: coach_finalize next_step contract fixed at four layers: (1) tools.py schema + prompts.py finalize clause demand an evidence-extracted move with success signal, forbidding goal restatement, filler, and quoting recalled focus text; (2) routers.py T-0027 repair replaces generic OR pasted-prose steps (fence/heading/>240 chars) with the reply's labelled action, never fabricates; (3) reply_continuity extractor recognizes 第一步/First step families, parenthetical qualifiers, bold-close both sides; (4) fresh workspaces get honest-empty current_focus instead of a synthetic imperative line glm-5.3 quoted verbatim. Real-provider validation (linksub + glm-5.3, fresh sidecar per sample, port-guarded): 4/5 samples emit the exact concrete step consistent with prose (.trainer-convergence/evidence/t0027-final-1..5.json). Residual 1/5 comes from ImplementationCoach._current_step needs_rescue template (pedagogy rescue lane, not coach_finalize) — registered as T-0029.

issues.title: Pedagogy rescue lane emits generic template next_step unanchored to the turn
issues.evidence: .trainer-convergence/evidence/t0027-final-5.json
issues.detail: When model finalize is missing and learner_state.needs_rescue, ImplementationCoach._current_step returns '先把 {target} 压成一个很小的补丁目标，再继续写。' with target defaulting to the lane label ('implementation'), unrelated to the turn's actual reply (an asyncio first step). Observed 1/5 real-provider samples. Fix direction: anchor rescue templates to the turn's reply action (reuse visible_next_step) or derive target from the turn content.
issues.resolution: Three-layer fix: (1) ImplementationCoach._target_label derives the template target from THIS turn's message subject when the lane label never appears in the message; (2) visible_next_step reads actions from label-headed sections with a bounded suffix whitelist (## 第一步代码 / ### Next steps); (3) router T-0027 repair treats rescue-template shapes as unanchored and prefers the reply's labelled action. Failure-first tests confirmed (2 new pytest tests failed pre-fix). Real provider glm-5.3: 5/5 samples turn-anchored — 3/5 fully concrete labelled actions, 2/5 anchored rescue directive (evidence/t0029-1..5.json). Full server suite 3666 green incl. bundled-mirror integrity guard.
